# Tao (Jonas) Chen

> Tao (Jonas) Chen is Provost's Chair Professor in Finance at Nanyang Business School, NTU Singapore. His research covers sustainable finance; FinTech, AI, and finance; and how investors and monitors shape corporate policy.

Provost's Chair Professor in Finance, Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. Email: jtchen@ntu.edu.sg.

## Publications — Sustainable Finance

How environmental, social and governance forces shape firm behaviour: pollution and environmental policy, social responsibility, tax practices, and the oversight of managers.

- [Ecological integrity of avoided deforestation projects](https://taochen.org/research/ecological-integrity-avoided-deforestation-ncc-2026/) — Kelly Ong, Tao Chen, Zhimin Chen, Carlos T. Pérez-Brito, Yiwen Zeng. Nature Climate Change 16, 2026. DOI 10.1038/s41558-026-02657-2. In one sentence: Most accredited avoided-deforestation carbon projects do not maintain the ecological condition of forests better than comparable unprotected areas.
- [Minimum Wages, State Ownership, and Corporate Environmental Policies](https://taochen.org/research/minimum-wages-state-ownership-jfqa-2025/) — Tao Chen, Xi Xiong, Kunru Zou. Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 60, 2025. DOI 10.1017/S0022109024000644. In one sentence: Minimum wage increases lead industrial firms to pollute more and to cut abatement, and state ownership reduces these effects. PDF: https://taochen.org/papers/chen-xiong-zou-2025-jfqa.pdf
- [Labor unionization and real earnings management: Evidence from labor elections](https://taochen.org/research/labor-unionization-real-earnings-plos-one-2024/) — Vivek Astvansh, Beibei Wang, Tao Chen, Jimmy Chengyuan Qu. PLOS ONE 19, 2024. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0292889. In one sentence: Firms whose workers narrowly vote to unionize reduce real earnings management compared with firms where the vote narrowly fails. PDF: https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0292889&type=printable
- [The social cost of investor distraction: Evidence from institutional cross-blockholding](https://taochen.org/research/social-cost-investor-distraction-plos-one-2023/) — Vivek Astvansh, Tao Chen, Jimmy Chengyuan Qu. PLOS ONE 18, 2023. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0286336. In one sentence: When institutional investors hold blocks in several firms in an industry, they are distracted, and the social performance of those firms suffers. PDF: https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0286336&type=printable
- [Bank deregulation and corporate environmental performance](https://taochen.org/research/bank-deregulation-corporate-environmental-wd-2023/) — Shiyi Chen, Tao Chen, Pingyi Lou, Hong Song, Chenyu Wu. World Development 161, 2023. DOI 10.1016/j.worlddev.2022.106106. In one sentence: After bank branching deregulation in China, firms more exposed to the deregulation emit less pollution per unit of output. PDF: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm?abstractid=3633696
- [The Unintended Consequence of Land Finance: Evidence from Corporate Tax Avoidance](https://taochen.org/research/unintended-consequence-land-finance-ms-2022/) — Tao Chen, Youchao Tan, Jinghua Wang, Cheng (Colin) Zeng. Management Science 68, 2022. DOI 10.1287/mnsc.2021.4191. In one sentence: When Chinese local governments lose land-sale revenue, they enforce taxes more strictly and local firms avoid less tax. PDF: https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/pdf/10.1287/mnsc.2021.4191
- [Globalization and U.S. Corporate Tax Policies: Evidence from Import Competition](https://taochen.org/research/globalization-us-corporate-tax-ms-2022/) — Tao Chen, Chen Lin, Xiang Shao. Management Science 68, 2022. DOI 10.1287/mnsc.2021.4121. In one sentence: U.S. manufacturers facing more competition from Chinese imports increase their tax-reduction activities. PDF: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm?abstractid=3135205
- [Does credit rating conservatism matter for corporate tax avoidance?](https://taochen.org/research/credit-rating-conservatism-matter-af-2021/) — Tao Chen, Sidney Leung, Lingmin Xie. Accounting & Finance 61, 2021. DOI 10.1111/acfi.12773. In one sentence: When credit rating agencies become more conservative, firms engage in more tax planning. PDF: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm?abstractid=2966014
- [Institutional shareholders and corporate social responsibility](https://taochen.org/research/institutional-shareholders-corporate-social-jfe-2020/) — Tao Chen, Hui Dong, Chen Lin. Journal of Financial Economics 135, 2020. DOI 10.1016/j.jfineco.2019.06.007. In one sentence: Institutional shareholders improve the social and environmental performance of the firms they own. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/233ea276-ae9e-48aa-a0e6-3da3f18295f3/content
- [Does Information Asymmetry Affect Corporate Tax Aggressiveness?](https://taochen.org/research/information-asymmetry-affect-corporate-jfqa-2017/) — Tao Chen, Chen Lin. Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 52, 2017. DOI 10.1017/S0022109017000576. In one sentence: Firms avoid taxes more aggressively after they lose analyst coverage, which raises information asymmetry. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/62dbf0a8-be0d-4091-b4f0-bfcd5bfcdaea/content
- [Institutions, board structure, and corporate performance: Evidence from Chinese firms](https://taochen.org/research/institutions-board-structure-corporate-jcf-2015/) — Tao Chen. Journal of Corporate Finance 32, 2015. DOI 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2014.10.009. In one sentence: In China, weaker property-rights protection is associated with more outsiders on corporate boards, and in that environment outsiders improve firm performance. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/b4b3ac62-908e-4345-b740-a34203a173dd/content
- [Do analysts matter for governance? Evidence from natural experiments](https://taochen.org/research/analysts-matter-governance-natural-jfe-2015/) — Tao Chen, Jarrad Harford, Chen Lin. Journal of Financial Economics 115, 2015. DOI 10.1016/j.jfineco.2014.10.002. In one sentence: Financial analysts act as monitors: when a firm loses analyst coverage, its managers behave in ways that are worse for outside shareholders. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/6299832e-1610-46a8-8bd0-dcaa27a56f6e/content

## Publications — FinTech, AI, and Finance

How financial technology and artificial intelligence change access to credit, innovation, and the way consumers respond to technology-driven markets.

- [Cultural Lag, Consumer Literacy, and Coping in AI-Enabled Advertising: A Theoretical Explication and Managerial Solutions](https://taochen.org/research/cultural-lag-consumer-literacy-ja-2026/) — Chen Lou, Xuan Zhou, Elison Ai Ching Lim, Tao Chen, Edson C. Tandoc, Diotima Chattoraj. Journal of Advertising 55, 2026. DOI 10.1080/00913367.2026.2652377. In one sentence: Consumers’ beliefs, literacy, public policy and public education lag behind AI-enabled advertising, and most people cannot tell AI-enabled ads from traditional ones without disclosure. PDF: https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/00913367.2026.2652377
- [What influences demand for Buy Now, Pay Later credit?](https://taochen.org/research/influences-demand-buy-now-el-2024/) — Tao Chen, Ben R. Marshall, Nhut H. Nguyen, Nuttawat Visaltanachoti. Economics Letters 242, 2024. DOI 10.1016/j.econlet.2024.111857. In one sentence: In New Zealand, demand for Buy Now, Pay Later credit is higher among single, younger and lower-income people and falls when interest rates rise. PDF: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0165176524003410/pdfft
- [Authentically Fake? How Consumers Respond to the Influence of Virtual Influencers](https://taochen.org/research/authentically-fake-consumers-respond-ja-2023/) — Chen Lou, Siu Ting Josie Kiew, Tao Chen, Tze Yen Michelle Lee, Jia En Celine Ong, ZhaoXi Phua. Journal of Advertising 52, 2023. DOI 10.1080/00913367.2022.2149641. In one sentence: Followers see virtual influencers as uncanny but “authentically fake”: effective for brand awareness, but weak at persuading people to buy.
- [Finance and Firm Volatility: Evidence from Small Business Lending in China](https://taochen.org/research/finance-firm-volatility-small-ms-2022/) — Tao Chen, Yi Huang, Chen Lin, Zixia Sheng. Management Science 68, 2022. DOI 10.1287/mnsc.2020.3942. In one sentence: Access to FinTech credit on Alibaba’s platform makes small online businesses’ sales less volatile and makes them less likely to exit.
- [Impact of Competition on Innovations of IT Industry: An Empirical Investigation](https://taochen.org/research/impact-competition-innovations-it-jmis-2021/) — Tao Chen, Hsing Kenneth Cheng, Yong (Jimmy) Jin, Shengli Li, Liangfei Qiu. Journal of Management Information Systems 38, 2021. DOI 10.1080/07421222.2021.1962590. In one sentence: More product-market competition leads IT firms to produce more, and more highly cited, patents.
- [Financial innovation: The bright and the dark sides](https://taochen.org/research/financial-innovation-bright-dark-jbf-2016/) — Thorsten Beck, Tao Chen, Chen Lin, Frank M. Song. Journal of Banking & Finance 72, 2016. DOI 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2016.06.012. In one sentence: Financial innovation is associated with faster bank growth but also with greater bank fragility, and on net with higher economic growth where growth opportunities are better. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/5f4863e8-4fb2-4125-be36-91751b45f372/content

## Publications — Investors, Monitors and Corporate Policy

How analysts, owners, regulators and governments shape corporate investment, risk-taking and firm value.

- [Analyst coverage, executive compensation and corporate risk‐taking: Evidence from property–casualty insurance firms](https://taochen.org/research/analyst-coverage-executive-compensation-jri-2023/) — Tao Chen, Shinichi Kamiya, Pingyi Lou, Andreas Milidonis. Journal of Risk and Insurance 90, 2023. DOI 10.1111/jori.12437. In one sentence: When property–casualty insurers lose analyst coverage, they take more risk, especially where managers’ pay rewards risk-taking. PDF: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm?abstractid=3778633
- [Dual Ownership and Risk-Taking Incentives in Managerial Compensation](https://taochen.org/research/dual-ownership-risk-taking-rof-2023/) — Tao Chen, Li Zhang, Qifei Zhu. Review of Finance 27, 2023. DOI 10.1093/rof/rfad007. In one sentence: When more of a firm is owned by institutions that hold both its shares and its bonds, CEO pay is designed to encourage less risk-taking. PDF: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm?abstractid=3427030
- [Tariff uncertainty and firm innovation: Evidence from the U.S.–China Permanent Normal Trade Relation](https://taochen.org/research/tariff-uncertainty-firm-innovation-jef-2021/) — Tao Chen, Huasheng Gao, Yuxi Wang. Journal of Empirical Finance 62, 2021. DOI 10.1016/j.jempfin.2021.02.002. In one sentence: Lower uncertainty about future tariffs on Chinese imports led affected U.S. firms to innovate more. PDF: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm?abstractid=3396232
- [Marginal cost of risk-based capital and risk-taking](https://taochen.org/research/marginal-cost-risk-based-jbf-2019/) — Tao Chen, Jing Rong Goh, Shinichi Kamiya, Pingyi Lou. Journal of Banking & Finance 103, 2019. DOI 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2019.03.011. In one sentence: A diversification feature of risk-based capital rules leads insurers with lower marginal capital costs to buy riskier bonds. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/1fb0e88d-1050-44a5-ab23-eef7f1b846e5/content
- [Windfalls of emperors' sojourns: Stock market reactions to Chinese firms hosting high‐ranking government officials](https://taochen.org/research/windfalls-emperors-sojourns-stock-smj-2017/) — Douglas A. Schuler, Wei Shi, Robert E. Hoskisson, Tao Chen. Strategic Management Journal 38, 2017. DOI 10.1002/smj.2622. In one sentence: Investors react positively when Chinese firms host visits by the President or Premier, especially private firms and firms with weaker prior performance. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/7b473f91-25ea-4a43-a863-f3716aa6bf51/content
- [How does analysts' forecast quality relate to corporate investment efficiency?](https://taochen.org/research/analysts-forecast-quality-relate-jcf-2017/) — Tao Chen, Lingmin Xie, Yuanyuan Zhang. Journal of Corporate Finance 43, 2017. DOI 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.12.010. In one sentence: Higher-quality analyst forecasts are associated with more efficient corporate investment, reducing both under- and over-investment. PDF: https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/1a5312a0-9174-4d34-b97c-1002ab374cd4/content
